figurative_meaning_en: Fond of quarrels; full of extreme twists and complications
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা কূটকচালে লোক, সবসময় ঝগড়া বাধিয়ে দেয়।
এই ব্যাপারটা খুব কূটকচালে হয়ে গেছে, কোনো সমাধান নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real troublemaker, always stirring up quarrels.
This matter has become extremely complicated, with no easy solution.
note: This idiom is used to describe people or situations prone to unnecessary conflicts or intricate deceptions in Bengali folklore and daily speech.
